taglines: 8+ years building fintech and SaaS platforms.
Owned the workflow platform behind Dukascopy Bank's account, transfer and payment operations.
PHP 8.2, Laravel 10-12, Oracle PL/SQL and a from-scratch MySQL HandlerSocket client.
summary: Senior Backend Engineer with 8+ years in fintech and SaaS, specializing in PHP/Laravel, MySQL/PostgreSQL and Docker. At Dukascopy Bank built and owned the rule engine, 145 HTTP endpoints and the storage migration behind its account, transfer, crypto and payment operations; since January 2026 building independent products in TypeScript and Rust. Open to remote roles in EU, UK and US time zones (GMT+4).

highlights: Building independent products: Bakutrend, a Rust news aggregator polling 25 sources (MIT licensed), and the MMMC Platform, a multi-tenant building-management system on Next.js and PostgreSQL.
Deepening AI-assisted engineering: LLM APIs, RAG, MCP and the pit issue-to-draft-PR orchestrator for coding agents.
Expanding beyond PHP into Rust and Go.

experience.description: Swiss online bank providing trading and banking solutions.
highlights: Owned the account, transfer, crypto and payment paths on the bank's workflow platform: 213 Jira tickets delivered, junior engineers mentored and pull requests reviewed.

Built and maintained 145 HTTP endpoints (63 API, 81 web) and the 96-method JSON-RPC layer behind them, owning the main controller (65 methods) and creating the endpoint scaffolding generator the API team uses for controller and DTO stubs with OpenAPI specs.
Owned the rule engine that validates every workflow: 103 rule classes and 18 validators, including the account-balance rule and the account-closure active-workflow guard, both authored from scratch.
Drove the PHP 8.2 migration (924-file change set) and the Laravel upgrade, owning dependency hygiene across 43 composer.json changes.

Built the GDPR pipeline that erases customer personal data, and as sole author of the S3 and Azure Blob file-storage provider migrated account attachments from local storage to AWS S3 and then Azure Blob.
Integrated ActiveMQ over STOMP messaging and worked against Oracle PL/SQL banking packages through 35 repository wrappers.

Created dukascopy/handlersocket from scratch - the company's PHP client library for the MySQL HandlerSocket NoSQL plugin (first-listed composer author) - with two drivers, index abstraction, a Docker test harness and a PHPStan level 8 CI gate.

experience.description: Part-time advisory alongside Dukascopy for a partner and payments platform.
highlights: Led the PostgreSQL to MySQL migration of the platform's core data.
Owned the Docker development and production environments, two CI deployment workflows and release management from 1.3.4 to 1.4.3.
Hardened transaction handling and partner-balance logic, and reviewed the team's pull requests.

experience.description: Parent company of the UK financial comparison platforms Quotezone.co.uk and CompareNI.com.
highlights: Migrated a monolithic PHP component into a standalone microservice, reducing deployment dependencies and improving team autonomy.
Designed and implemented REST APIs for a React-based customer dashboard in collaboration with the frontend team.

experience.description: Leading IT solutions provider and system integrator in Azerbaijan.
highlights: Refactored a legacy data import module, improving stability and reducing processing errors.
Standardized engineering onboarding by containerizing the local development environment with Docker, reducing setup time from a full day to under an hour.
Developed and maintained client web applications using PHP/Laravel, including REST APIs and third-party service integrations.

projects.name: LevelUp / Eimtahan.az
highlights: Built the front end of an exam and school-management SaaS in Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand and Tailwind.
Implemented exam authoring and live exam monitoring, the multilingual content model and the production Docker image and CI pipeline.

projects.name: Bakutrend
highlights: Aggregates 25 news sources (RSS and Telegram) on a five-minute poll, clusters duplicate events and scores prominence from independent coverage, views per hour, age decay and spread.
Offline end-to-end pipeline test with an injected clock; clippy-clean; MIT licensed.

projects.name: MMMC Platform
highlights: Multi-tenant apartment-building management: owners, charges and debt, meetings with voting, tickets and an audit trail.
Built on Next.js 16, PostgreSQL and Drizzle with 8 Vitest suites and Playwright end-to-end tests.
Enforced a lint rule banning database-client imports in server-action files, then migrated every write into audited transactional services.

projects.name: pit
highlights: Issue-to-draft-PR orchestrator that drives a coding agent: allowlist and consent checks, push preflight, retries, timeouts and an SSE cockpit.
Node 24 and Ink/React, with an offline test suite.
